Name: Measures must have format string
Description: Selects measures with no format string. Measures that return text are exempt.

Name: Visible measures should have descriptions
Description: Selects visible measures with no description.

Name: Avoid bidirectional cross filtering on fact tables
Description: Selects relationships that filter in more than one direction.

Name: Calculation groups must have positive precedence
Description: Selects calculation groups whose precedence is not positive.
